Thanks again for the renewal conversation last week. Per our call, I put together a short proposal that pairs the annual renewal with a new isolated on‑prem branch (secure enclave) for your analytics workloads. High level:

- Term: transition from 12m to 36m to secure the 18% volume discount on reserved cluster capacity
- New environment: 3x isolated clusters (NVMe-backed), dedicated KV caching, air‑gapped option for PHI flows
- Capacity: baseline 250 token RPS with burst to 800 RPS across the three clusters; autoscale and standby capacity included
- Target cutover window: Q4 2027 (preferred)

I've attached the proposal and a starter SoW for your review. Can we schedule a 30‑minute ops + legal sync this week to align on timelines and any procurement/deployment constraints? Ben will follow up on pricing detail, and Priyom is available to walk through the topology.

Attachments: NexusFarm-Proposal-v1.pdf, SoW-NexusFarm-v2.docx, Topology-branch-diagram.png

2) Procurement timeline and PO constraints — procurement@nexusfarm.com
3) Technical kickoff (Priyom/Marissa) — pick a slot this week

Thanks — look forward to connecting.
